## Description

Schedule vs given (age, vaccines, date, status Given / Reported by guardian / Due / Upcoming), record dose given (vaccine, batch/lot, expiry, site & route, given by, next due), recall reminders.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Only if clinically approved for scope (intake record).
- [ ] **AC2.** Dose records capture batch, expiry, site/route and giver; next due computed per schedule.
- [ ] **AC3.** Recall reminders respect consent and contain no clinical details.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
